intro: Opens at the 7:50 slow end; RPE ≤7 anchor governs. The reopen condition stays armed — a firm over-anchor read here reopens the band toward 7:50–7:55 ahead of the W19 arbitration (Adj #241/#222).

cardio.workout: 6×1000m @ T, 60 s jog recoveries. Reps ~4:52 each (7:50/mi = 7.7 mph at 1% on a treadmill, the nearest tick to the slow-end ask). WU 1.0–1.25 mi easy + 2–3 min build to T; CD 1.0 mi easy. Total ~6.4 mi.

targets.pace: 7:50/mi on the reps (band 7:45–7:50); WU/CD 9:15–10:30/mi; jog rec 10:00–10:30/mi

cardio.warmup: 1.0–1.25 mi easy jog, then 2–3 min building 8:15 → 7:50/mi.
cardio.cooldown: 1.0 mi easy Z1 + 5–8 min SI prehab.
cues: Run all six at 7:50 — a fast open invalidates the test (Adj #222 pattern); a firm over-anchor read at the slow end is what reopens the band.
